### THE BREAKDOWN

 Tesla confirmed a formal Cybercab launch event in Austin on September 3, 2026.
 The two-seat Cybercab has no steering wheel or pedals and relies on Tesla's AI4 computer for full autonomy.
 The September 3 event is a product unveiling, not NHTSA approval, and public access will remain limited. [...] Tesla has locked in the date. The Cybercab, a two-seat robotaxi with no steering wheel and no pedals, gets its formal launch event in Austin on September 3, 2026. Invitations are going out to selected riders and fans, and coverage from outlets like Teslarati lines up with what invitees are seeing

results.content: According to Tegtmeyer's recap, the next scheduled milestone on Tesla's public calendar is the Cybercab Launch Event on September 3, 2026 — less than two weeks away as of this post. The Cybercab has been positioned since We, Robot as the purpose-built hardware for that ride-hailing network: a two-seat, low-cost vehicle designed from the start around the assumption that no human will be driving it. A dedicated launch event suggests Tesla is ready to move that platform from concept-car reveal [...] Tesla's transformation from an electric vehicle manufacturer into a physical AI company is no longer a talking point — it's a documented arc with dates, product launches, and a September 2026 event
results.title: Tesla's Physical AI Pivot: From We, Robot to Cybercab and Optimus
